items.title_en: ‘Arranged Marriage Is A Scam’: Bengaluru Man With ₹3 Lakh/Month Salary Struggles To Find A Match; Internet
items.title_zh: “包办婚姻是一个骗局”：月薪 30 万卢比的班加罗尔男子很难找到匹配对象；互联网
items.summary_en: A viral X post about a 31-year-old Bengaluru man earning Rs 3 lakh a month facing repeated arranged marriage rejections has sparked a debate over preferences and expectations
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于一名月入 30 万卢比的 31 岁班加罗尔男子多次遭到包办婚姻拒绝的 X 帖子在网上疯传，引发了关于偏好和期望的争论

items.title_en: Voice behind Delhi Metro takes grandson on first ride, little boy’s reaction goes viral
items.title_zh: 德里地铁背后的声音带孙子第一次乘坐，小男孩的反应疯传
items.summary_en: For his grandson Rushaan, hearing that familiar voice echo through a Metro coach for the first time was a moment of sheer surprise, and one that his grandfather captured on video.
items.summary_zh: 对于他的孙子 Rushaan 来说，第一次听到地铁车厢里回响着熟悉的声音是一个完全惊讶的时刻，他的祖父在视频中捕捉到了这一时刻。

items.title_en: Egyptian shopkeeper catches child falling from balcony: ‘Had no time to think’
items.title_zh: 埃及店主抓住从阳台坠落的孩子：“没有时间思考”
items.summary_en: CTV footage from Giza Governorate captured the moment shopkeeper Ahmed Ragab sprang into action to catch a 4-year-old boy who fell from a second-floor balcony after briefly tangling in a washing line.
items.summary_zh: 吉萨省的中央电视台镜头捕捉到了店主艾哈迈德·拉加布 (Ahmed Ragab) 立即采取行动去接住一名 4 岁男孩的瞬间，该男孩因短暂地被晾衣绳缠住而从二楼阳台坠落。

items.title_en: Indian man slaps Kick streamer inside Vietnam 7-Eleven: How the incident unfolded
items.title_zh: 印度男子在越南7-11便利店内掌掴Kick彩带：事件是如何展开的
items.summary_en: The Kick streamer pointed his camera at the Indian man in the convenience store and kept recording him.
items.summary_zh: Kick主播将相机对准了便利店里的印度男子，一直在拍摄他的视频。

items.title_en: Israeli singer learns Shah Rukh Khan song to honour Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar
items.title_zh: 以色列歌手学习沙鲁克·汗的歌曲以纪念迪拜航空飞行员斯密特·马赫查尔
items.summary_en: The musician learned the Hindi song and dedicated his performance to “brave” Captain Machchhar and Indians worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 这位音乐家学习了这首印地语歌曲，并将他的表演献给“勇敢的”马赫恰尔船长和全世界的印第安人。
